# masterdaweb_firewall_macros (Data Source)

The named services a firewall rule can name instead of a protocol and ports (macro), like SSH or HTTPS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "masterdaweb_firewall_macros" "all" {}

output "macros" {
  value = [for m in data.masterdaweb_firewall_macros.all.macros : m.name]
}
```
